en.topic_title: Chinese Communist Party outlines closer scrutiny of officials

zh.topic_title: Chinese Communist Party outlines closer scrutiny of officials

en.topic_title: Chinese Communist Party outlines closer scrutiny of officials
en.topic_summary:
The Chinese Communist Party is set to tighten oversight of its officials by scrutinising their assets and online activities, according to a party document released on Sunday.



Xi Jinping speaks at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CCP Central Commission for Discipline Inspection in January 2026. Photo: PRC Ministry of Justice.



The document from the CCP’s powerful Central Committee was published by the Xinhua state news agency following this week’s annual plenary session in B
